subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as one umbrella until all three branches are resolved, or land the linked jitter fix and split the SecretRef/CDP-service leftovers into narrower follow-ups?
rationale: The central crash-loop bug has a concrete linked PR, but the remaining SecretRef and CDP/service-isolation parts cross security diagnostics, service supervision, and product scoping that automation should not collapse without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land jitter, split leftovers
options.body: Review the linked jitter migration PR as the immediate fix path, then split unresolved SecretRef and CDP/service-isolation behavior into narrower issues before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical until jitter migration, SecretRef diagnostics, and service/CDP isolation are all independently proven fixed.

options.title: Close after jitter only
options.body: Close this after the linked PR lands if maintainers decide the current SecretRef and service coverage is sufficient and no follow-up tracking is needed.

recommendation.title: Land jitter, split leftovers
recommendation.body: Review the linked jitter migration PR as the immediate fix path, then split unresolved SecretRef and CDP/service-isolation behavior into narrower issues before closing this umbrella.
